name: revised-down
about: §4R L2: Meta revised yesterday's numbers down overnight; the fold holds only the revised figures, which are smaller than the first report.

output.headline: On 2026-11-02, 1 campaign ran and delivered 2 leads at $55.45 each.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet was the only campaign active, spending $110.90 to reach 6,015 impressions, earn 70 clicks at a 1.2% click rate, and bring in 2 leads.
Month-to-date spend on Meta for 2026-11 sits at $198.00 with 29 days left in the month.
The mature 2026-09-21 cohort produced 38 leads: 33 contacted (86.8%), 17 converted (44.7%), 10 applied (26.3%), 4 hired (10.5%), and 8 lost after conversion (21.1%).
The mature 2026-09-28 cohort produced 40 leads: 36 contacted (90.0%), 20 converted (50.0%), 12 applied (30.0%), 5 hired (12.5%), and 9 lost after conversion (22.5%).
The 2026-10-26 cohort has 12 leads so far — 9 contacted, 3 converted, 1 applied, 1 lost after conversion, and no hires recorded yet — but it is too young to judge its rates.
Qualified leads and leads lost before becoming applicants are not recorded in the system.
